name: io.github.tonyyang0504/evalai-mcp
description: EvalAI (competitions): me, discover, get_competition, standings, enter. Every tool maps to a documen

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_EVALAI_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: EvalAI auth token from https://eval.ai/web/profile ('Get your Auth Token'; the token the evalai CLI uses). Sent as Authorization: Bearer.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_EVALAI_PARTICIPANT_TEAM_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric id of your EvalAI participant team (from GET /api/participants/participant_team or the Participant Teams page); needed only by `enter`.
